Name: Zinna's Scarecrows
Author: Zinnalynn
Description: This is an [AT] Pack of my [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22033]Spoopy Scarecrows[/url] mod, with even more color variations of some of them! Each of the skins can be applied with the paint bucket from the [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod. They work on the crafted scarecrow, the Rarecrows, and the Deluxe Scarecrow.
